encode_sound.claim: Every satisfying CNF assignment makes the expression true under its input values.

encode_complete.claim: Every true input valuation has a concretely constructed satisfying auxiliary extension.

encoding_iff.claim: For every fixed input valuation, expression truth is equivalent to existence of a satisfying CNF extension agreeing on inputs.

comparison.domain: All expressions of depth at most two over false, true, x, y, NOT, AND, and OR; five deeper sharing/complement/commutativity regressions.
comparison.go_path: encode(model, initial), Circuit.dimacs, lrat.Parse, and exhaustive assignment search with fixed inputs.
comparison.lean_path: Reconstruct source expression, encode symbolic clauses, enumerate every auxiliary valuation with the forced one atom true.
checks: Go recursive evaluation equals Go emitted-CNF satisfiability.
Lean recursive evaluation equals Lean symbolic-CNF satisfiability.
Go and Lean results agree for every tested input valuation.
Kernel-evaluated adapter regressions check nested negation and rejection of non-backward references.

scope.proved: Logical Tseitin clauses over symbolic atoms; all expression sizes and arbitrary input valuations.
not_proved: Numeric allocation or a mapping into the numbered RUP clause database.
Go constant folding, commutative caching, implementation refinement, or DIMACS serialization.
Oak frontend semantics, base/step obligation construction, enums, bit-vector arithmetic, XOR, or other operators.
Correctness of the JSON comparison adapter beyond its specific regression examples.

artifacts: Proof diagnostics, generated comparison corpus, and agreement logs are retained for 30 days in the opt-in soundness artifact.
